# Review - PR 503 @ efce10eb7a5323c2fae642f4b765f02dd7e2e25f

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 0314470e9e9cab3affd0e1a8bb2d8896d423859b. Documentation and policy only: 12 files, 231 insertions / 74 deletions against merge base ea5d5d9f19c9cd2de43fa12414deeb58bd198bef on `main`, moving the owner inbox to pinned issue #500, making it permissions-only, reassigning project-outcome decisions to main, and keeping a goal change outside main's authority; no Lean, blueprint or paper statement is touched.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope and method. `git merge-base github/main efce10eb` is `ea5d5d9f`, so the main-relative diff is the PR's own change; I read all twelve file diffs in full (`.githooks/pre-commit`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/paper-gaps/command.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md`, `local/DESIGN.md`, the main / mathfix / orchestrator personas, `local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md`, `issues-prs.md`, `sessions.md`) and then read the changed sections whole at this head. Trusted policy came from github/main at 0314470e: `local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, the `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5 checklist, and the AGENTS.md faithfulness and commit-convention sections. All six earlier marked reviews on this PR were read.

Prior findings. The one unresolved finding at the last reviewed head f4f7fd5b (review 5238443353, F1: the bar on main changing the stated project goal existed only in `local/protocols/issues-prs.md`, while the four operative documents stated the #500 scope exclusively and so read as granting main that authority) is repaired by the single new commit efce10eb. The carve-out now appears verbatim in all four named places - `local/personas/main.md:21-22`, `AGENTS.md:698-699`, `local/DESIGN.md:112-113` and `local/personas/orchestrator.md:36-38` - each immediately after the sentence that grants main project-outcome decisions, so the grant and its exception are read together; `issues-prs.md:265` and `:332` keep the two governing statements, `:337` keeps "Recording a decision never substitutes for that owner decision on the goal", and the PR's own ledger entry states the same bar. The earlier minor findings stay repaired at this head: `docs/paper-gaps/command.tex:33` loads `[T1]{fontenc}` and nothing else in `docs/paper-gaps/` loads fontenc, so no option clash is possible; from a clean `git archive` export of this head I compiled `policy.tex` with pdflatex (exit 0, no errors in the log), which covers the `\texttt{...<n>...}` placeholders; "ids continue after B11, so the next id is B12" is correct against live state, where `BLOCKER B11` is the highest id on issue #500; and `policy.tex:117-119` keeps the source-semantics, faithfulness-audit and independent-review conditions that section 6 imposes.

Independent checks. Proof integrity is not in play: the diff contains no Lean, no blueprint entry, no `\lean` / `\leanok` / `\uses` tag and no statement, so it can neither weaken nor trivialize a claim, and it introduces no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or decision-procedure shortcut; no source-labelled declaration changed, so nothing had to be compared against `references/qpbt-paper`. The pre-commit change is comment and message text only - the `INFRA_CHANGED > 1000` guard and its `MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE` condition are byte-identical to the base, `sh -n` on the head's hook passes - and the new wording agrees with `issues-prs.md:242-245` and `main.md:199-201` that the override follows a recorded main decision rather than a self-grant. The documented inbox CLI matches the implementation: `gh_common.py:483-485` defines `ensure-pr-comment` with a positional number, a positional marker and a required `--body-file`, exactly the invocation at `issues-prs.md:285-286`, and the split of the immutable `<!-- owner-inbox id=B<n> -->` identity marker from a separate `<!-- owner-inbox-status=... -->` body field is what the marker-substring lookup and PATCH need. Live state matches the prose: #500 is open and titled as the permissions-only v2 inbox, #26 is titled as archived and superseded, and every surviving #26 mention outside `EVOLUTION.md` history is an archival statement or, in the gap register at `:27` and `:43-44`, explicitly labelled historical provenance. The "Astra availability has been reported" premise that replaces the old conditional routing is supported: the astra poller note sits on #26 (2026-09-05 15:38Z), `dispatch.sh:60,461` carries the `mathfix` role, and the telemetry at this head records `gpt-6-astra` sessions. Hygiene: `git diff --check` is clean and no added line exceeds 100 characters except the gap-register table row, which was already over that length before this PR. Exact-head CI at efce10eb: aggregate state success, `local-ci/summary` success with all eight step contexts success.

Prose lane. The only mathematical prose touched is `docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex` and the gap register. The policy paragraphs restate section 6 and make no stronger claim than it does; the register row change only labels the #26 citation as archived and alters neither the recorded Magic Square correction nor its Lean column; no status marker, declaration link or blueprint entry changed, so no equivalence or `\leanok` question arises.

Three non-blocking observations, none of which I treat as a finding. The newest commit subject, "docs(policy): carry the project-goal bar into the persona and design docs", is 73 characters against the "Subject under 72 characters" line of AGENTS.md:584, and its `policy` scope covers changes to the personas, AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md; repairing it would require rewriting the head and discarding this head's CI. `docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex:123` and `local/protocols/sessions.md:225-226` still state the #500 scope exclusively without naming the goal exception, but neither grants main authority over the goal (policy.tex is scoped to mathematical nonconvergence and definition or game corrections, sessions.md to nonconverged project outcomes) and both explicitly defer to section 6, so no document now reads as giving main that authority. The PR body's Description is an auto-generated commit list that includes commits carried in from main, and its Testing line describes `lake env lean` checks for a documentation-only diff.

Not checked: no build was run and no Lean file elaborated, because none changed; no live GitHub mutation on #500 was exercised, so the inbox lifecycle is verified against the code and the prose only; the blueprint and the paper mirror were not consulted, since no source-labelled statement appears in the diff.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)

goal remain decisions for the owner.

### Description

- Update agent conventions, personas, design and workflow protocols to use
  issue #500 and retain issue #26 only as historical provenance.
- State the project-goal restriction beside the delegation in each governing
  document, and describe the short blocker format, stable identity marker and
  separately updated status field.
- Preserve the mathematical faithfulness audit and independent-review
  requirements for definition or game corrections. Update the corresponding
  paper-gap policy prose and fix the font encoding for literal placeholders.
- Record the protocol amendment. The pre-commit hook's guard logic is
  unchanged; no Lean statement, blueprint entry or paper statement changes.

### Testing

- All nine exact-head local CI contexts passed on `efce10eb`.
- The fresh independent reviewer confirmed the goal restriction in all four
  documents named by the prior finding, checked the CLI against `gh_common.py`,
  and verified that the hook's guard logic is unchanged.
- Hook shell syntax and whitespace checks passed. A clean export of the head
  compiled `policy.tex` with pdflatex without errors. No Lean elaboration was
  needed for this documentation change.

---
Closes #501
